purpose: autonomous deep research agent producing cited reports
key_patterns: planner/executor split: planner generates research questions, executors gather per-question in parallel
pluggable search backends (Tavily/Exa/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG) behind one retriever interface
inline citation in generated report
fit: retriever-interface + planner/executor map directly onto connector/pack architecture

outline-first, then section-grounded synthesis with per-section references
separation of knowledge curation from article generation

caching modes with explicit bypass
